name: smwmusic-trip-world-world
title: Trip World - World 1
description:
A small arrangement of the first stage song, from Trip World, which is made by the same team of Mr. Gimmick. Tried to maintain most of the notes which were being cut by the original song, due to limitations, while adding some other things, which I thought it'd be nicer on the song.

It does uses the KSS soundfont.
